headline: China Huawei convicted at US criminal trial stemming from Iran business
label: NEWS
caption:
A major legal ruling brings corporate tech and international politics together. 📱

According to Reuters and KFGO, China's Huawei has been convicted at a US criminal trial. 

The conviction stems from the company's business activities involving Iran.

The case is part of a sprawling legal process handled in the United States.
